def comps(D,c0):
    h,w=D.shape; seen=set(); out=[]
    for y in range(h):
        for x in range(w):
            if (y,x) in seen or D[y,x]!=c0: continue
            st=[(y,x)]; cc=[]
            while st:

def load():

    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
D1=np.array(G['Demo pair 1 input']); O1=np.array(G['Demo pair 1 output'])
D2=np.array(G['Demo pair 2 input']); O2=np.array(G['Demo pair 2 output'])
D3=np.array(G['Demo pair 3 input']); O3=np.array(G['Demo pair 3 output'])

# Rule check on all demos: find closed rings of nonzero-color c0; among those whose interior has >0 nonbg cells and NONBG STRICTLY OUTCOUNTS BG, choose one with LARGEST interior area; output = bbox with border recolored to dominant interior nonbg color, interior kept.
from collections import Counter
def solve(D):
    h,w=D.shape; cnt=Counter(int(v) for v in D.ravel()); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    def comps0(c0):
        seen=set(); out=[]
        for y in range(h):
            for x in range(w):
                if (y,x) in seen or D[y,x]!=c0: continue
                st=[(y,x)]; cc=[]
                while st:
                    yy,xx=st.pop()
                    if (yy,xx) in seen or D[yy,xx]!=c0: continue
                    seen.add((yy,xx)); cc.append((yy,xx))
                    for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=yy+dy,xx+dx
                        if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and D[ny,nx]==c0: st.append((ny,nx))
                out.append(cc)
        return out
    best=None
    for c0 in set(int(v) for v in D.ravel())-{bg}:
        for cc in comps0(c0):
            ys=[p[0] for p in cc]; xs=[p[1] for p in cc]
            y0,y1=min(ys),max(ys); x0,x1=min(xs),max(xs)
            H,W=y1-y0+1,x1-x0+1
            # must be proper ring: at least 3x3
            if H<3 or W<3: continue
            ok=all(D[i,j]==c0 for i in (y0,y1) for j in range(x0,x1+1)) and all(D[i,j]==c0 for i in range(y0,y1+1) for j in (x0,x1))
            if not ok: continue
            inner=[[int(D[i,j]) for j in range(x0+1,x1)] for i in range(y0+1,y1)]
            nn=sum(1 for v in inner.ravel() if v!=bg); nb=sum(1 for v in inner.ravel() if v==bg)
            if nn==0: continue
            if nn<=nb: continue
            if len(inner.flatten()<4): continue
            dom=max(set(v for v in inner.ravel() if v!=bg),key=lambda v:sum(1 for vv in inner.ravel() if vv==v))
            key=(nn-nb,-len(inner))
            if best is None or key>best[0]: best=(key,(y0,x0,H,W),inner,dom)
    if best is None: return None
    _,(y0,x0,H,W),inner,dom=best
    out=[[dom]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for r_,row_ in enumerate(inner):
        for c_,v in enumerate(row_):
            out[r_+1][c_+1]=v
    return out
for name,(di,do_) in [('d1',(D1,O1)),('d2',(D2,O2)),('d3',(D3,O3))]:
    r=solve(di)
    print(name,'match', np.array_equal(np.array(r) if r else None, do_), np.array(r).shape if r else None, do_.shape)

def solveF(D):
    h,w=D.shape; cnt=Counter(int(v) for v in D.ravel()); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    best=None
    for c0 in set(int(v) for v in D.ravel())-{bg}:
        for cc in comps(D,c0):
            ys=[p[0] for p in cc]; xs=[p[1] for p in cc]
            if not ys: continue
            y0,y1=min(ys),max(ys); x0,x1=min(xs),max(xs)
            HH,WW=y1-y0+1,x1-x0+1
            if HH<3 or WW<3: continue
            ok=all(D[i,j]==c0 for i in (y0,y1) for j in range(x0,x1+1)) and all(D[i,j]==c0 for i in range(y0,y1+1) for j in (x0,x1))
            if not ok: continue
            inner=[[int(D[i,j]) for j in range(x0+1,x1)] for i in range(y0+1,y1)]
            flat=[v for r_ in inner for v in r_]
            nn=sum(1 for v in flat if v!=bg); nb=sum(1 for v in flat if v==bg)
            if nn<=nb: continue
            dom=max(set(v for v in flat if v!=bg),key=lambda v:sum(1 for vv in flat if vv==v))
            dc=sum(1 for v in flat if v==dom)
            key=(dc*1000+(nn-nb),-len(flat))
            if best is None or key>best[0]: best=(key,(y0,x0),HH,WW,dom,inner)
    if best is None: return None
    _,(y0,x0),HH,WW,dom,inner=best
    out=np.full((HH,WW),dom,int)
    for r_,row_ in enumerate(inner):
        for c_,v in enumerate(row_):
            out[r_+1][c_+1]=v
    return [[int(v) for v in row_] for row_ in out]
